title: Add Agent Task Log JSON export
summary: Agent Task Log now supports JSON export of selected rows with detailed context including task information, messages, actions, and page snapshots, with access control based on agent-management permissions.
key_points: Added JSON export action to Agent Task Log list for selected rows
Export includes task details, messages, related actions, page context, tools, and memorized data
Enforces agent-management access control and redacts snapshots without Troubleshoot All Agents permission
Refactored calculation helpers to share logic between detail page and export functionality
Added focused JSON and context tests for export behavior
quote: add a selected-row JSON export action to the Agent Task Log list
